name: Stonepaste body
summary: A body of ground quartz, glass frit and a little white clay. It is white and hard, and it takes a thin glaze, but it is not as clear as porcelain.
how: Grind quartz pebbles to a fine powder.
Mix with glass frit and about 10 per cent of white clay.
Shape the body on the wheel or in a mould.

origin.note: Potters of the Near East make a white quartz body to imitate Chinese porcelain.

adoptions.via: Iznik potters make dishes and tiles of a white quartz body under a clear alkaline glaze.
